dog.description_text:
Mila is a 4-year-old dachshund who weighs around 10 lbs, and she is happiest when she can be right by your side. She’s incredibly sweet, cuddly, and loves being close to her people as much as possible.

She can be a little shy around other dogs and is still working on both house-training and crate-training. Mila will do best with an adopter who has experience with dachshunds, or who understands the breed and is ready for all the personality, attachment, and consistency that can come with these little dogs.

Registered adopters interested in Mila can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
